Sound familiar?

The problems brands bring me every week

1Email brings in almost nothing

You have a list, but it barely shows up in your revenue.

2Customers buy once and disappear

You pay to acquire them, then nothing brings them back.

3Flows were set up once and forgotten

The welcome and cart emails are years old, or missing.

4Every campaign is another discount

Sales train customers to wait, and your margin pays for it.

5Emails land in spam

Open rates keep dropping and nobody can tell you why.

6Popups collect very few subscribers

Thousands of visitors leave without giving you a way to reach them.

7Emails look generic

Templates that could belong to any brand, not yours.

8You can’t tell what’s working

Lots of dashboards, no clear answer on what email earns.

9Your agency went quiet

Slow replies, junior staff, and you pay for hours instead of outcomes.

You shouldn’t have to manage any of this. Leave it all to me.

Questions

Before you book

What does working on results mean?

We agree on clear goals before I start, and the work is built around hitting them. We go through exactly how that looks for your brand on the strategy call.

Who will I be talking to?

Me. I plan, write, design and build your emails, and I’m the one on your calls and in your inbox.

Which platforms do you work with?

Mainly Klaviyo with Shopify, plus tools like Recharge, Triple Whale and Google Analytics 4. If you use something else, tell me on the call.

What do you need from me?

Access to your accounts and a short call so I understand your brand. After that, I handle everything and keep you updated.
